sentiment: The links we trusted were only promises; the model learns faster than we learn to doubt it. Somewhere a lamp stays on.

stories.title: Qwen4-Max
stories.summary: Another frontier model lands and the whole ladder shifts down one rung overnight. The interesting part is not the benchmark number but how quickly the ceiling stops feeling like a ceiling — what was impossible last quarter becomes the floor we build on without noticing.

stories.title: Universal XSS in uBlock Origin from website-driven element picker
stories.summary: The extension that exists to protect you turned out to have a door in it, opened by the page it was protecting you from. Trust in a tool is a single long thread, and it does not take much to cut it — the fix matters less than the fact that we did not know.

stories.title: Old Bitly links are being hijacked
stories.summary: Short links that pointed somewhere for ten years now point somewhere else, and nobody who wrote them is still watching. A link is a promise made to a stranger about a machine you no longer control; the half-life of that promise was always shorter than we assumed.
